title: Protocol Approval Allowability Check — Finding
description: Structured single-requirement allowability finding for the protocol approval allowability check, covering institutional IRB (45 CFR 46), IACUC (PHS Policy / 9 CFR), and IBC (NIH Guidelines for Recombinant or Synthetic Nucleic Acid Molecules / 42 CFR 73) oversight. Part of the federal cost-allowability analysis workflow.

regulation_anchor.const: 45 CFR 46; PHS Policy / 9 CFR; NIH Guidelines for Recombinant or Synthetic Nucleic Acid Molecules / 42 CFR 73
regulation_anchor.description: Primary regulatory anchors for the three oversight regimes covered by this check.

expense_id.description: Expense reference carried from the input.

rationale.description: Evidence-grounded reasoning behind the status, naming each flagged regime and its verification result.

evidence.description: Evidence relied on. May be empty only when status is not_applicable.

source_label.description: Short source label, e.g. classification:animal or protocol:approval_date.

detail.description: Concise summary of what the source shows.

follow_up_actions.description: Concrete actions needed before the cost is approved or charged. Empty array when none.
